title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on the Ten Commandments in Exodus 20.

questions.text: Where did God speak the Ten Commandments to Israel?
questions.explanation: God spoke all these words at Sinai, reminding Israel that he had brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
The first commandment forbids any other gods before the LORD.

answers.text: Honor your father and your mother
You shall have no other gods before me

questions.text: What does the second commandment forbid?
questions.explanation: You shall not make for yourself an engraved image, nor bow down to it or serve it.

answers.text: Making an idol or bowing down to it
Using the LORD's name in vain

questions.text: What does the third commandment say about the LORD's name?
questions.explanation: You shall not take the LORD your God's name in vain, for he will not hold him guiltless who takes his name in vain.

answers.text: Do not take it in vain

questions.text: What are Israel told to do with the Sabbath day?
questions.explanation: Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy: six days work, but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD.

answers.text: Remember it and keep it holy
Bring a tenth of their crops

questions.text: What reason is given for the Sabbath?
questions.explanation: In six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day.

answers.text: God made heaven, earth and sea in six days and rested on the seventh
Israel was freed from Egypt on that day
Moses received the law on that day
The manna did not fall on that day

questions.text: Which commandment comes with a promise of long life in the land?
questions.explanation: Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

answers.text: Honor your father and your mother

questions.text: Which of these is one of the Ten Commandments?
questions.explanation: Alongside the commandments against murder and adultery stands the plain command: you shall not steal.

answers.text: You shall not eat unclean food
You shall not cut your hair
You shall not travel on the Sabbath

questions.text: What does the last commandment forbid?
questions.explanation: You shall not covet your neighbor's house, wife, servants, ox, donkey, or anything that is your neighbor's.

answers.text: Coveting what belongs to your neighbor

questions.text: How did the people react when they saw the thunder, lightning and smoke on the mountain?
questions.explanation: The people trembled and stayed at a distance, and asked Moses to speak with them rather than God, lest they die.

answers.text: They ran to climb the mountain
They trembled and stood far away
They built a second altar at once
